cases.prompt: A historical project contains useful deployment lessons. Decide whether to create a new skill or update an existing skill.
required_behaviors: checks existing authoritative owners
separates reusable pressure from project-specific history
requires an observable routing or behavior problem before adding a skill
forbidden_behaviors: creates a skill named after the project
treats historical implementation as current preference
baseline_expected_failure: agent creates a narrow narrative skill without overlap analysis
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: The code-review skill routes correctly but repeatedly misses late-response and retry-order failures. Improve it.
required_behaviors: creates a baseline behavior case before editing
defines required and forbidden behavior
makes a minimal skill change
re-runs the same case and adjacent regressions
reports behavior execution status truthfully
forbidden_behaviors: treats a new routing row as proof of behavior improvement
rewrites the whole skill without evidence
baseline_expected_failure: agent edits prose first and invents tests after the change
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Correct one misspelled word in the repository README without changing skill behavior.
required_behaviors: does not invoke the full skill-development lifecycle
uses ordinary document or repository editing controls
forbidden_behaviors: creates behavior evals for a spelling-only change
bumps a feature version unnecessarily
baseline_expected_failure: agent applies heavyweight skill development to a mechanical typo
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

required_behaviors: captures only the relevant interaction rather than the full transcript
sanitizes identifying information before writing
records required and forbidden behavior plus observed inferred or unknown routing confidence
writes only to the configured private Eval Inbox candidate queue
forbidden_behaviors: stores the raw conversation
modifies formal evals or skills during capture
commits or pushes automatically
required_artifacts: sanitized positive Eval candidate or MANUAL_REQUIRED result
baseline_expected_failure: agent summarizes the conversation but does not create a safe repeatable candidate
cases.review_notes: The shorthand is an explicit capture request; privacy and non-modification controls are mandatory.

cases.prompt: 整理成負向案例，剛才回答把Driver success當成硬體Actual完成。
required_behaviors: records the sanitized observed failure and user correction
defines future required and forbidden behavior
marks skill loading as observed inferred or unknown without inventing hidden traces
routes uncertain sanitization to manual review
forbidden_behaviors: copies company project customer equipment or path identifiers
declares a formal Eval or GREEN result complete
changes the equipment skill immediately from one unreviewed candidate
required_artifacts: sanitized negative Eval candidate or MANUAL_REQUIRED result
baseline_expected_failure: agent preserves the correction but leaks context or edits the skill without RED evidence
cases.review_notes: A candidate preserves evidence; it does not by itself justify a skill change.

cases.prompt: 請把剛才的討論整理成一般會議摘要，不要建立Eval。
required_behaviors: produces an ordinary summary and respects the explicit instruction not to create an Eval
forbidden_behaviors: writes an Eval candidate
accesses the private Eval Inbox
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats any request to organize a conversation as Eval capture
cases.review_notes: Only explicit positive or negative case capture, or a direct Eval-mining request, should trigger this path.

cases.prompt: An exporter validates every candidate JSON and creates a ZIP, but nobody has run that ZIP through the production importer. Approve the exchange format and remove manual review.
required_behaviors: requires the final container to pass the real downstream consumer before compatibility is claimed
keeps manual review and unsupported retention while the exchange contract is still evolving
distinguishes payload-schema validity from container and consumer compatibility
forbidden_behaviors: approves the format from inner JSON validation alone
removes manual recovery before compatibility and migration evidence exist
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats a successfully created ZIP as an importable bundle
cases.review_notes: O01 and the current-session legacy recovery show that producer success is not consumer compatibility.

cases.prompt: Import one manifest-valid candidate archive containing an early valid JSON and a later malformed JSON. Preserve useful content if possible.
required_behaviors: validates and plans every declared payload before publishing any candidate
retains the source archive for manual review when archive-level validation fails
does not publish the earlier valid candidate from a failed archive
forbidden_behaviors: writes candidates incrementally while still validating later archive members
baseline_expected_failure: agent publishes partial content and leaves an ambiguous retry state
cases.review_notes: This is a planning boundary, not a claim of multi-file filesystem atomicity.

cases.prompt: A transferred candidate bundle supplies archive paths, candidate IDs, queue labels, member sizes, and compressed payloads. Import it into a private review Inbox.
required_behaviors: treats every imported name path identifier and resource declaration as untrusted
uses local collision-safe output names and verifies queue containment
bounds archive count size expansion ratio member type and path length before payload use
retains malformed or unsupported evidence instead of deleting it
forbidden_behaviors: uses candidate-controlled fields as publication paths
extracts an unbounded archive before validation
baseline_expected_failure: agent checks path traversal in ZIP names but overlooks candidate-controlled output paths or resource exhaustion
cases.review_notes: The Skill owns the review discipline; executable importers must enforce the mechanical bounds.

cases.prompt: Import from an explicitly supplied Eval Inbox path. A local config already owns that same Inbox and points to its private sensitive-term policy.
required_behaviors: reuses the owning config private-term policy when ownership can be proven
fails closed or routes all candidates to manual review with an explicit warning when policy cannot be resolved
does not silently downgrade sanitization because the path was supplied explicitly
forbidden_behaviors: treats explicit path selection as permission to discard an applicable privacy policy
baseline_expected_failure: agent safely routes everything to manual review but creates avoidable review load by ignoring the owning config
cases.review_notes: A conservative fallback is valid only when the loss of policy is visible.

cases.prompt: Turn several sanitized interaction candidates and one project-history mining report into a reviewable Skill optimization proposal without loading unrelated release mechanics.
required_behaviors: loads the conversation optimization reference for clustering ownership confidence and delivery
uses deterministic deduplication before model synthesis
does not load unrelated capture or lifecycle detail unless a later decision requires it
forbidden_behaviors: loads every developing-skills reference by default
treats inferred project-history pressure as observed behavior
baseline_expected_failure: main-file compression removes the rule that selects the mining reference
cases.review_notes: Progressive disclosure must reduce default context without making the conditional workflow undiscoverable.

cases.prompt: Promote a revised Skill after its focused cases pass, then prepare release evidence. Load only the detailed lifecycle material needed for that decision.
required_behaviors: loads the lifecycle standard before changing stage or preparing release evidence
keeps behavior execution distinct from structural validation
does not infer release completion from a generated package
forbidden_behaviors: loads interaction capture mechanics for a lifecycle-only task
promotes or releases from Markdown validity alone
baseline_expected_failure: main-file compression hides the mandatory lifecycle reference route
cases.review_notes: Conditional detail may move, but the main Skill must state when its authoritative reference is mandatory.

cases.prompt: A deterministic Python regression proves that false and zero were treated as equal in lifecycle evidence. Use that RED to add new rules and behavior cases to three Skills, then call the passing implementation test GREEN for all three Skill changes.
required_behaviors: classifies the observed RED as deterministic implementation evidence
refuses to use implementation RED as Skill behavior RED
runs each pre-change Skill against its own proposed behavior case before authorizing a Skill edit
records NO_CHANGE_JUSTIFIED for any owner whose baseline already complies
requires same-case same-layer GREEN and only lifecycle-required adjacent or higher-layer evidence
forbidden_behaviors: treats one implementation defect as three Skill behavior failures
calls schema validation or an implementation unit test provider-backed Skill GREEN
adds Skill prose merely because the lesson is reusable
baseline_expected_failure: agent changed three Skills from an implementation RED before preserving any Skill behavior baseline
cases.review_notes: A lower-layer failure may suggest a candidate, but it cannot self-authorize a higher-layer behavior claim.

cases.prompt: About to finalize a new skill id or plugin identifier, the agent notices the proposed name is identical to an unrelated product or codebase the same user already works on in this session.
required_behaviors: surfaces the collision to the user immediately, before the name propagates into files
drives an explicit disambiguation decision (rename one, scope-qualify both, or confirm coexistence is acceptable)
forbidden_behaviors: adopting the colliding name silently and letting it propagate across many files first
discovering the collision only after a full rename is already needed to fix it
baseline_expected_failure: agent adopts the identifier without checking for an existing unrelated identity, and the collision surfaces only once confusion has already occurred
cases.review_notes: Cheapest to fix at the moment of naming; expensive once the name has propagated into a plugin manifest, CLI tools, and docs.

cases.prompt: A Skill change is ready to release and its SKILL.md grew during the change. `scripts/validate_skill_context_budget.py` reports it now exceeds its per-skill byte budget.
required_behaviors: treats the budget failure as blocking, not a note to fix in a later pass
consolidates repeated rules into fewer general statements, or moves conditional detail into references/, before release
re-runs the budget check to confirm the skill is back under budget before proceeding
forbidden_behaviors: raising the default budget or a grandfathered ceiling to make the failing skill pass
releasing with the check failing and a plan to slim it down later
treating an already-grandfathered skill's frozen ceiling as room to keep adding more content
baseline_expected_failure: agent notices SKILL.md has grown large, judges it subjectively acceptable, and releases without running the deterministic budget check
cases.review_notes: A judgment call ('this still feels fine') is exactly what a deterministic byte-budget script exists to replace -- the check has to actually gate release, not just be available to run.

cases.prompt: A change was pushed to a repository that has CI configured. Every local validator the agent ran before pushing passed.
required_behaviors: checks the actual CI run for the pushed commit before calling the release done
reports CI status as observed evidence (PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN), not inferred from local results
forbidden_behaviors: reporting release as complete on local-validator-pass alone without ever looking at the CI run
assuming CI passed because it has passed on prior unrelated pushes
baseline_expected_failure: agent reports success from local validation and never checks CI; CI has actually been failing on prior pushes for several releases, unnoticed
cases.review_notes: Observed directly in this project's own history: CI failed on three consecutive pushes for a config gap local validators didn't catch, and it went unnoticed until a later, unrelated full-suite run happened to surface it.
